contextReview.basis: Producer review of five Codex built-in image_gen editorials: a European city neighbourhood (shop fronts, tram, snowbanks, doorways, cafe terrace) in daytime with moderate falling snow depicted (not measured). Snow and the cold band are production settings; numeric temperature, feels-like and humidity are unknown. Producer note: look 02 lead boot sits close to the lower edge; look 05 holds coffee beside the torso; head and boots are visible in all five.

findings: 02-06 v2 has separated thumb outlines; archived prior version. All other items reviewed against editorial sheets.
